CATEGORY: 1

This is a functional behavior issue that can be verified through conceptual analysis without needing to build or run code. This is a logical/functional issue that can be verified by examining the code that handles the relationship between the tempo setting and the LFO rate calculation, particularly focusing on how the sync off state is handled. No build environment is needed to verify if the solution correctly decouples the LFO rate from the tempo when sync is disabled.
